source.label: Bob's Guide to Classic Pinball Machines

supportingSources.label: Karyn Kiser at IFPA 2018 National and Women's Championships

strategy.summary: On Abra Ca Dabra, complete 1-2-3-4 early, score the moving lit drop, and use the lit center target to reset the banks and raise their value.

steps.text: Plunge for a missing number. Prefer 2 or 3 if a 1 or 4 plunge feeds the center.
Complete 1-2-3-4 as soon as possible. The numbers carry between balls.
Shoot 1 and 4 directly. Bank a shot behind lowered drops to reach 2 or 3.
Hit the lit drop targets. Switch hits move the lit target.
If a bank is almost complete, finish its unlit targets.
When the center target lights, hit it to reset the drops and raise the target value.
Repeat. Score the lit drops at the higher value.

quickInfo.name: Number lanes
quickInfo.summary: Complete 1-2-3-4 to score and advance the lit drop-target value; number progress carries between balls.

quickInfo.name: Lit drop
quickInfo.summary: Switch hits move the lit target, so read the bank before choosing a rebound.

quickInfo.name: Center reset
quickInfo.summary: After the required bank progress, the lit center target resets the drops and raises their value.

quickInfo.name: Team One variant
quickInfo.summary: Use the Team One route below: it has six numbered lanes, soccer-ball lamps, and add-a-ball awards that are commonly converted to points for tournaments.

fallback.title: Number lanes
fallback.when: Use this plan when the center target or drop rebounds are unsafe.

steps.text: Use the lower inlanes to complete missing numbers.
Complete 1-2-3-4 to score and raise the target value.

alternatives.title: Team One add-a-ball route
alternatives.when: Use this route on the 1977 Team One add-a-ball version, especially when its add-a-ball awards are converted to points.

steps.text: Plunge a missing number; prefer 2 or 3 if the outer lanes can return down the center.
Complete all six numbered lanes while taking lit soccer-ball targets when their rebounds are controlled.
Work through both five-target banks. From a cradle, backhand an exposed upper number or lit target when that angle is repeatable.
When add-a-balls are converted for competition, prioritize the converted point awards over unsafe completion attempts.
Hit the lit center target after completing the required drop bank.

techniques.name: Banked number-lane shot
techniques.instruction: After a drop is down, bank the ball through the opening to reach the hidden 2 or 3 lane.

cautions.issue: A plunge into lane 1 or 4 can return straight down the middle.
cautions.response: Test the first plunge. Use lane 2 or 3 when an outer plunge feeds the center.
Use the outer 1 and 4 lane shots when they are the safer repeatable shots.

checkBeforePlay: Identify Abra Ca Dabra or Team One, then read the installed ball count and whether add-a-ball, Extra Ball, and Special awards convert to points.
Confirm number-lane carry, lit-target maximum, bank reset, center-target requirements, tournament conversions, and tilt settings.
Test every number lane, both drop banks, lit targets, upper exits, slingshots, outlanes, and target rebounds.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Abra Ca Dabra, collect numbered lanes 1 through 4 early because they carry between balls, then hit the drop target carrying the moving lit award. When the center target lights, hit it to reset both banks at a higher target value and repeat. On Team One, instead collect its six numbered lanes and finish the two target banks for the add-a-ball awards shown on that version.
strategy.overview: In Abra Ca Dabra, numbers 1 through 4 carry between balls, switch hits move the lit drop award, and the lit center target resets the banks at a higher value. Complete the numbers, take safe lit drops, finish a nearly complete bank, then hit the center target and repeat at the higher value. On Team One, use its six numbered lanes and two five-target banks, prioritizing converted add-a-ball awards only when their shots are controlled.
